title: Glossary
description: Project vocabulary. Defines all domain terms used across specs. Version 2.0.0.

project.description: Must match project name across all other specs.

terms.description: All domain terms. Each must be independently understandable.

definition.description: Definition of this glossary term. Required.

name.description: Name of this glossary term. Required.

description.description: Description of this glossary term. Synonym for 'definition' — use for graph visualization consistency. If omitted, falls back to 'definition'.

examples.description: Optional concrete examples that clarify the definition.

synonyms.description: Other names for this term used in the project. Synonyms should not have their own entry.

relatedTerms.description: GL-NNN identifiers of other terms in this glossary that are closely related.

category.description: Required. Grouping tag for the term.

reqRefs.description: REQ-IDs from GoalSpec that reference this term. Populated during requirement writing. Use for GL→REQ traceability.

fnRefs.description: FN-IDs from ApiSpec that use this term. Populated during API design. Use for GL→FN traceability.

id.description: Unique glossary term identifier. Format: GL-NNN (3-digit zero-padded, sequential).
